root_cause: growth_events.is_robot flags only part of the automated traffic. Since 25 Oct, 707 attribution roots were unflagged yet only 3 to 4 showed any human action; 93 roots with 8 or more views accounted for 1,836 views. Funnel and page metrics built on is_robot alone overstate human visits roughly a hundredfold against GA4 (about 19 sessions in 14 days).
fix: Two read-only views classify each attribution root and summarise per day. Reports and agents should use verified_human for conversion rates and treat unverified as unknown.
prevention_rule: Funnel and page performance must be computed on verified human traffic, never on raw page views or is_robot alone.

invariants: no access for anon or authenticated
